title: Edge deploy evening cribsheet
content:
Quick cribsheet for Site C (edge rack) evening handover - personal scratchpad. Keep terse.

Context:
- Customer: Acme Manufacturing, Site C (tier-2 factory floor).
- Bundle: private deployment (VPC peering + on-prem appliance).
- Today: final networking checks, cert rotation, smoke test before morning handoff.
- Primary on-site contact: Priya Suresh (IT), +1 415-555-0198.

High-level checklist (what I ran / to verify):
- [x] Confirmed site rack power redundancy (A/B PDUs ok).
- [x] Appliance powered and IPed on mgmt VLAN (10.60.4.10).
- [x] VPC peering tunnel up to prod-VPC (us-west-2) - BGP learned prefixes.
- [x] Firewall rules: allowed TCP 443/10250/10251 from prod egress subnets.
- [ ] ACME ops to open SNMP port for monitoring (reminder: org policy needs approval).

Networking notes / gotchas observed:
- Peering: BGP flapped once during config push; fixed by increasing hold-time on peer (customer default was 30s, bumped to 90s).
- NAT: customer has a NAT gateway that rewrites src port for outgoing control-plane calls; added static SNAT for appliance mgmt to avoid ephemeral port changes that break keepalives.
- Private DNS: internal names resolve only after adding conditional forwarder to Site C DNS server -> needed to add 10.60.4.11 as forwarder.

Certificates / identity:
- We rotated the appliance certs (internal CA). Steps used: 
  1) csr.sh on appliance -> base64 csr -> uploaded to Acme CA portal -> issued cert chain.
  2) Installed full chain via /opt/redwood/certs/ and restarted redwood-agent service.
- Reminder: customer CA enforces EKU for TLS client auth; include OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2 when generating CSR.
- Troubles: initial cert install failed with pkcs12 parse error -> fixed by converting to PEM with openssl pkcs12 -in cert.p12 -nodes.

Commands I ran (copied for quick replay):
- Check agent: systemctl status redwood-agent && journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200
- BGP summary on appliance: bgpctl show neighbors | grep -i established
- DNS test: dig @10.60.4.11 model-registry.acme.internal A +short
- Smoke generation test: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <test-token>' https://10.60.4.10/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' --insecure -v

Observed errors and immediate mitigations:
- Error: 502 from local NGINX when proxying /v1/generate after cert rotation.
  - Cause: NGINX config still referenced old cert bundle path -> symlinked /etc/nginx/certs/current.pem to new chain and reloaded nginx.
- Error: Reductions in throughput under stress test (~30% below expected).
  - Observed CPU pinned on one GPU host due to old nv_peer_mem kernel module present; removed module and rebooted node (nv_peer_mem conflicts with host kernel).

Smoke tests & acceptance (what to show customer):
- 3x sequential generate calls, < 220ms p95 on short prompts (we hit 190ms on average).
- Embedding endpoint returns vector length 1536 and stable across repeated calls.
- Rolling restart: restart single worker, confirm no 5xx for 3m under low load.

Open items / next actions (for morning):
- [ ] Confirm ACME ops will add SNMP rule + conditional DNS changes (owner: Priya).
- [ ] File support ticket for transient BGP flap root cause (include router logs and timestamps).
- [ ] Post-provision: run full load harness overnight and collect token-level latency breakdown in Console.
- [ ] Update Confluence page with final site IPs and cert thumbprint (CONFLUENCE-DEPLOY-TEMPLATE-9123).

Reminders to self (notes-to-self):
- If site loses NTP skew >5s, our agent loses token rotation -> watch for 401s in agent logs.
- Keep a minimal set of commands in the incident binder: curl tests, nginx diff, systemctl commands, bgp show.
- When handing off, leave Priya a short runbook file on rack laptop: /home/siteops/redwood-handoff.txt (I copied a sanitized version).

Quick paste: handoff blurb for morning message to Priya/ACME ops:
"Thanks Priya — we completed the network and cert steps tonight. Please review the SNMP and DNS changes requested in the ticket. Overnight load run will validate throughput; we expect to be green by 08:30 PT. If you see any 401 or 502, call me at +1-415-555-0177."

End of cribsheet. Keep this file as ephemeral personal notes; I'll fold important bits into Confluence tomorrow.
